accountId.description: The ID of the Signicat account, in a valid UUID format.

aggregatedAt.description:
The timestamp when the statistics were aggregated.

**Format**: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

platform.description:
The platform for which the detailed device statistics were obtained.

**Possible values**: It can be either `ANDROID` or `IOS`.

name.description:
The name of the property.

**Note**: The name depends on what is passed for the `type` and `platform` query parameters in the operation request.

count.description: The number of devices with this property.

percentage.description: The percentage of devices with this property.
